headline: Southern Company Reports Q3 2026 Earnings of $2.0 Billion
summary: Southern Company reported third-quarter 2026 earnings of $2.0 billion, or $1.77 per share, up from $1.7 billion, or $1.55 per share, in the same period of 2025.
why: Southern Company is a major American gas and electric utility holding company, serving as a key component of the U.S. energy infrastructure sector.
